description: Find new-build housing projects (empreendimentos) in Portugal on flatin.pt. Filter by municipality, parish, typology T0–T5, budget, construction stage, delivery year and energy class. Each result has the price range per typology, stage, promised delivery date, developer, coordinates and the canonical page URL to cite. Prices come from developers' pages with the date they were checked. Use get_newbuild for one project's units, purchase cost and surroundings.

delivery_by.description: Completed, or promised for this year or earlier (overdue promises included), e.g. 2027. Projects with no announced date are left out

energy_class.description: Energy certificate class of at least one unit, as stated by the source. Often not published: filter only when asked

language.description: Language of the page URLs and labels: pt, en, ru, ua, de, fr, nl. Default en

municipality.description: City / municipality (concelho): name, slug or four-digit code, e.g. Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia, Matosinhos, 1312. English names (Lisbon) and accents-free spelling are understood; an ambiguous name (Lagoa) is refused with candidates

on_sale.description: Only projects with a published price. Default false

parish.description: Parish (freguesia) name, e.g. Paranhos. Exact name, accents optional

price_max.description: Budget upper bound in euros, e.g. 350000. With typology, the budget applies to those typologies' prices. Projects with no published price are left out when a budget is given

sort.description: price (cheapest first, default), name, delivery (soonest first), new (recently added first). Projects with a price always come before those without

stage.description: Construction stage: planned, licensed, building (under construction), selling (on sale), delivered (completed)

typology.description: Bedrooms: T0 studio … T5 (five or more). Any of the listed matches

name: search_newbuilds
title: Search new-build projects in Portugal
